senses.gloss: m. (infin. of זמזם tinnire, P. Sm. 1132, v. זָמַם I) playing on a tingling instrument.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 104a:17">Erub. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>כי קלא דז׳</he> as the sound of tingling; [Ms. M. <he>דמן מזומה</he>, Ms. Alf. <he>כי זמומי</he>; Asheri: <he>כמו זִימְזוּמֵי</he>; Sefer ha-Ittim <he>כמַזְמוּטֵי</he>].
